metadata.title: YAML-driven XML template pipeline: real D2Q9 BGK Poiseuille channel
metadata.description: Anchor case for XVAL-LBM-YML-DRIVEN-XML-TEMPLATE-PIPELINE. This case is wired to the REAL TensorLBM solver (tensorlbm.verification.zou_he_channel, D2Q9 BGK + Zou-He pressure closures) via reference.solution_fn, so the pipeline verdict is produced from a genuine converged LBM field compared with the exact plane-Poiseuille solution -- not from the demonstration stubs. Geometry: two solid wall rows, effective height H = ny - 2.

reference.citation: Exact plane Poiseuille flow, u(y) = G/(2 nu) * yt * (H - yt); Schlichting & Gersten, Boundary-Layer Theory
